about: The SQL gdash runs, for G-SQL's dialect measurements. Generated by scripts/gen_sql_corpus.py; do not edit.
notes: runs_on 'source' is sent to the customer's database (PostgreSQL, ODBC) by a refresh; it never runs on the staging store. runs_on 'store' runs on SQLite today and on G-SQL after migration.
Visual and ask SQL bind :name params; gdash rewrites them to positional ? before running (gdash_sql.bas).

Visual SQL names sibling datasets unqualified (orders) or schema-qualified (orders.orders), because each dataset is an ATTACHed file whose table has the dataset's name. On G-SQL, with datasets as tables in one database, the qualified form goes away.
Money columns hold INTEGER minor units, so a literal compared to one is in minor units (amount > 1000 means $10.00).

statements.note: <marks> is one ? per column. Runs once per row, all rows inside one transaction.

statements.note: Every attach is read-only: the bound value is a file: URI with mode=ro.
